loginCopy: Create and manage development workspaces, connect through SSH or Web Shell, and organize credentials and files.
noOrganizationAdmin: Create an organization, then refresh the console.
noOrganizationMember: Ask an organization administrator to add you.
keyHint: Choose a recognizable name; Unicode is allowed, for example “Windows gaming PC key”
encodingHelp: Use UTF-8 for text; encode binary files as Base64.
fileModeHelp: Linux file mode, such as 644 for configuration or 600 for private files.
targetHelp: Enter a variable name for environment variables or an absolute workspace path for files.
ownerHelp: Optional Linux user name for the file in the workspace.
groupHelp: Optional Linux group name for the file in the workspace.
templateSelectorHelp: When selected, this item applies to workspaces created from that template.
labelSelectorHelp: Optional; inject only when all workspace properties match. No JSON required.
noSelector: No conditions; applies to all workspaces matching the scope and template.
templateSelectorHint: Select a template or leave empty
multilineHint: Whitespace and trailing newline are preserved
sensitiveHelp: Stores the value as sensitive. Its original text is hidden when editing and omitted from audit records.
lockedHelp: Organization administrators can prevent user and workspace entries with the same name.
credentialWriteOnly: Enter the complete new value when editing. The list shows its name, target, and version.
sshTargetHelp: The public key authorizes SSH access to matching workspaces. Its target path is managed automatically.
workspaceAutocomplete: Type a name or short ID to find a workspace
name: Name
templatePersistenceHelp: A template supplies the image, resources, and access method. A workspace keeps the configuration used when it was created.
workspaceResourcesHelp: Template values are used by default. Per-workspace values must satisfy Pod requests and organization and user quotas.
internalHelp: Best for connections through a private network or Tailnet.
publicHelp: Connect through the public SSH entry or Web Shell.
selectedReferenceHelp: The list shows names, types, and targets. Template and applicability conditions are also applied.
searchWorkspacesHint: Filter by name, short ID, state, image, or user
noMatchingWorkspaces: No workspaces match the current filter.
sshConnectionIntro: Add the host block to your local SSH config first, then connect through its alias. Codex App should use that same alias.
codexAppAliasHelp: Use the SSH alias as the Codex App hostname. Leave the port blank so SSH reads it from the config.
sshConfigInstallHelp: Append the full block to ~/.ssh/config and verify the fingerprint before accepting the host key.
adminOnly: This area is visible only to system administrators and administrators of the current organization.
noQuotaPermission: Only system or organization administrators can change quota.
workspaceHighRiskConfirm: This workspace will receive cluster-management privileges. Create it?
deleteWorkspaceConfirm: Delete this workspace? Its persistent storage and runtime resources will also be removed.
revokeMemberConfirm: Revoke this user's membership and new SSH access?
templateHighRiskConfirm: This template will grant cluster-management privileges. Create it?
disableTemplateConfirm: Disable this template? Existing workspaces are kept.
deleteTemplateConfirm: Permanently delete this disabled template if no workspace references it?
initialTokenPrompt: Initial API token (at least 32 bytes; shown once after creation)
workspaceUserHelp: Existing non-root image user used for SSH login and file ownership.
workspaceHomeHelp: Persistent storage mount and HOME for the workspace user; it must be an absolute path.
templateYamlHelp: View and edit the complete template YAML. Format and fields are checked before saving.
templateNameHelp: A recognizable template name shown during workspace creation; Unicode is allowed.
templateImageHelp: The OCI image used by this template; it must be in the image allowlist.
ephemeralHelp: Temporary container space, excluding the persistent workspace disk. Leave empty to omit this request or limit.
preserveHomeOwnershipHelp: Keep the existing owner and mode of the persistent storage root.
buildkitHelp: Attach a rootless image builder; buildctl can build OCI images from Dockerfiles without a Docker daemon or host Docker socket.
maintenanceAccessHelp: For maintenance workspaces that need to manage cluster resources.
nodeListHelp: Comma-separated cluster node names; leave blank for no constraint.
keyValueLinesHelp: Enter one KEY=value per line; values may contain additional equals signs.
pluginsDescription: Install and manage extensions, and control the features each plugin may use.
pluginsEmptyHint: Install the first plugin to add the features your workspaces need.
pluginsEmptyMemberHint: Installed plugins will appear here after a system administrator adds them.
pluginSourceAdministratorConfirmed: Source and digest reviewed by an administrator
pluginSchemaChanged: The plugin schema changed. Workspace creation fails closed until this scope is reviewed and saved.
pluginConfigurationInvalid: The effective configuration does not satisfy the plugin schema. Correct and save it.
pluginSensitiveGuidance: Plugin configuration must not store passwords, tokens, keys, or other secrets. Use envelope-encrypted credential injection instead.
pluginDeleteOverrideConfirm: Delete this override and restore the inherited configuration?
pluginOverrideDeleted: The override was deleted and inherited values are effective again.
pluginSchemaRejected: This plugin's configuration form cannot be displayed safely.
pluginSensitiveSchemaRejected: The plugin configuration contains a sensitive field. Use Credentials and Files instead.
pluginValidationInvalid: Value does not satisfy this field's constraints
pluginVersionConflict: Another administrator updated this configuration. Close and reopen it before saving.
pluginInvalidConfiguration: The configuration did not pass server-side schema validation.
pluginNotFound: The plugin is not loaded or was removed after a service restart.
pluginUninstallConfirm: Uninstall this plugin and all of its configuration?
pluginCompileFailed: The plugin could not start. Check its version or reinstall it.
pluginSchemaInvalid: The plugin configuration structure is invalid.
pluginInterfaceIncompatible: The plugin interface is incompatible with this platform version.
pluginManifestFileHelp: Select the manifest.json supplied with the plugin.
pluginComponentFileHelp: Select this file when it is declared by the manifest.
pluginAssetFilesHelp: Select the page assets declared by the manifest; multiple files are supported.
pluginReleaseRequired: Enter the GitHub repository, release tag, and asset filename.
pluginExpectedSha256Help: Confirms that the download matches the checksum published by its author.
pluginUpdateIdMismatch: The selected update belongs to another plugin.
pluginInspectionExpired: This review has expired. Check the plugin package again.
pluginPermissionReviewHelp: Select only the features this plugin may enable. You can revise them with a later update.
pluginAuthorizationConfirm: I reviewed the plugin source, version, and feature access above and authorize this installation.
pluginContributionHelp_workspace_create_: Review workspace requests before creation and reject requests using declared rules.
pluginContributionHelp_configuration: Store installation- or organization-level settings for this plugin.
pluginContributionHelp_ui_surfaces: Add an independent plugin page or feature area at declared locations.
pluginContributionHelp_api_routes: Provide independent API paths handled by the plugin.
pluginContributionHelp_api_middleware: Participate in authorized API request flows.
pluginSurfaceInvalid: This plugin page could not be opened.
pluginSurfaceActionUnavailable: The action requested by this page is currently unavailable.
invalidFileMode: File mode must be three octal digits with one optional leading zero, such as 600 or 0644.
templateEnvironmentDialogHelp: Manage environment variables and files for this template with the same editor used in Credentials & Files.
templateEnvironmentSelectorHelp: This item applies to the current template.
saveTemplateBeforeEnvironmentFiles: Save the template before configuring its environment variables and files.
noTemplateEnvironmentFiles: This template has no dedicated environment variables or files
invalidTemplateNumber: A resource value is empty, outside the allowed range, or not aligned to its field step.
resourceRequestExceedsLimit: CPU and memory requests cannot exceed their respective limits.
ephemeralRequestExceedsLimit: The ephemeral-storage request cannot exceed its limit.
deleteCredentialConfirm: Delete this credential or file? Workspaces using it will update their configuration.
deleteCredentialUnavailable: This item cannot be deleted here.
profileSettingsHelp: Update the name and avatar shown across your organizations.
avatarUrlHelp: Use an HTTPS image URL, or leave blank for a stable generated avatar.
organizationSwitchHelp: Switching organization changes the scope of workspaces, credentials, and administration pages.
apiKeysHelp: Create separate keys for devices and automation. A key value is shown only once.
apiKeyCreatedHelp: Copy and store it securely now. It cannot be shown again.
auditSearchHint: Search actor, workspace, or audit metadata
auditWorkspaceHint: Name, short ID, or workspace ID
auditAllScopes: All scopes, including system and personal
storagePolicyHelp: Set limits for reproducible runtime, build, and tool data. These values do not change the workspace's persistent disk capacity.
runtimeTmpMemoryHelp: Fast temporary files for running processes that can be recreated with the workspace.
buildScratchHelp: Space used to unpack sources and produce intermediate files during builds.
buildkitCacheHelp: Used when BuildKit is enabled. The value is kept when BuildKit is off so it is ready for later use.
codexScratchHelp: Reproducible temporary data used while Codex runs.
homeReserveHelp: Free space reserved on the persistent disk. Leave blank to use the smaller of 1 GiB or 10% of disk capacity.
